name.title: Hands that protect the world.
name.p1: Our logo shows two open hands holding a drop of water with the globe inside it. It stands for what we do every day: protect people, their workplaces and the world they live in.
name.p2: Equipment and training sit under one name, so the gear your team wears and the way they use it come from the same people.

about.statement: For {{years}}+ years we have helped sites, factories and offices across Kerala choose the right protection — and taught their people to use it well.

leader.title: Led by experience on the ground.
leader.text: Our founder brings {{years}}+ years in the safety field. That experience shapes every product we recommend and every session we run.

right.title: The right gear
right.text: We recommend equipment that fits the job and the standard — not just what is on the shelf.

trained.title: Trained people
trained.text: Equipment only works when people know how to use it. Training is half of what we do.

honest.title: Straight answers
